n1.speaker: plumber
n1.text: Afternoon! I'm Dave — the plumber who Tom rang this morning. Where's the boiler?

translations.fa: عصر بخیر! من دیوام — لوله‌کشی که تام امروز صبح بهش زنگ زد. پکیج کجاست؟

branches.suggestion: It's in the cupboard which is next to the kitchen.
Come in. It's the white box that's making a noise.
branches.suggestionFa: بفرمایید. همون جعبهٔ سفیده که صدا می‌ده.

n2.speaker: plumber
n2.text: Right, let's see. Is this the pressure gauge that was showing zero?

translations.fa: خب، ببینیم. این همون فشارسنجیه که صفر نشون می‌داد؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, that's the one that Tom was worried about.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، همونیه که تام نگرانش بود.

branches.suggestion: I'm not sure. Tom's the person who knows.
branches.suggestionFa: مطمئن نیستم. تام کسیه که می‌دونه.

n3.speaker: plumber
n3.text: There's your problem — a small leak from the pipe that goes under the floor. That's why the pressure dropped.

translations.fa: مشکلتون همینه — یه نشتی کوچیک از لوله‌ای که زیر کف می‌ره. واسه همینه که فشار افت کرده.

branches.suggestion: Is it the pipe where the floor is wet?
branches.suggestionFa: همون لوله‌ایه که کف اونجا خیسه؟

n4.speaker: plumber
n4.text: Spot on. It's an easy job — I've got a part in the van which should do it. About an hour.

translations.fa: دقیقاً. کار آسونیه — یه قطعه تو ون دارم که باید درستش کنه. حدود یه ساعت.

branches.suggestion: That's great. Would you like a cup of tea?
How much will it cost, roughly?

cultureNote.en: Offering tradespeople a cup of tea is a strong British custom. "Milk, two sugars" is the classic answer!
cultureNote.fa: به تعمیرکار چای تعارف کردن رسم بریتانیایی است.

n5.speaker: plumber
n5.text: Ooh, go on then — milk, two sugars. It'll be about ninety quid including the part. I'll give Tom a receipt.

translations.fa: اوه، باشه پس — با شیر، دو قند. با قطعه حدود نود پوند میشه. به تام رسید می‌دم.

branches.suggestion: Here's your tea. Shout if you need anything.
branches.suggestionFa: اینم چاییتون. اگه چیزی لازم داشتید صدا کنید.

branches.suggestion: Is there anything we should do to stop it happening again?
branches.suggestionFa: کاری هست که جلوی تکرارش را بگیریم؟

n6.speaker: plumber
n6.text: Get it serviced once a year — that's the best advice I can give. Lovely cuppa, this. Right, back to work!

translations.fa: سالی یه بار سرویسش کنید — بهترین توصیه‌ای که می‌تونم بکنم. چه چای خوبی. خب، برگردیم سر کار!
